pages.text: Cape Coral Emergency Physicians Home ABOUT US CONTACT US EMPLOYMENT FAQ'S Welcome Our Team Home ABOUT US CONTACT US EMPLOYMENT FAQ'S Welcome Our Team About Us Since 1985, the Cape Coral Emergency Physicians, a dedicated group of Board Certified Emergency Physicians have been accepting the challenge of delivering high quality emergency services to the residents of Cape Coral and the surrounding communities. In 1985 Cape Coral Hospital had a 5 bed emergency department and Cape Coral had a population of less than 60,000 residents. Today Cape Coral has a population of over 180,000 and has one of the busiest Emergency Room in Lee County treating over 80,000 patients a year. Rededicated in 2005 as the Weigner Taeni Center for Emergency Services, the emergency room has expanded with a new 15 room Fast Track area. This fast track unit provides treatment for minor care issues including lacerations, fractures and other non-life threatening injuries. The area is manned with a physician and a mid-level provider and is equipped to provide all radiology and laboratory services within the department. The emergency physicians are complimented with a staff of highly skilled mid-level providers such as Physician Assistants and Advanced Registered Nurse Practitioners. Together they treat the patients of Cape Coral from minor injuries and illnesses to life threatening emergent care. We are proud to have been a part of the Cape Coral community for over 30 years and look forward to serving the needs of the residents in the years to come. Box 151368 Cape Coral Fl 33915 office: 239-424-3513 fax: 239-424-4039 admin@ccepfl.com Billing Company for CCEP Cape Coral Emergecny Physicians, LLC Department 1000 PO Box 986549 Boston, MA, 02298-6549 www.PhysicianBillPay.com (239)319-3618 For additional billing questions or issues contact Vantra Health billing@ventrahealth.com or call 1-800-418-5438 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET For medical records request: Please use ChartSwap.com Provider Information, Cape Coral Emergency Physicians Attn: Cape Coral Hospital (Florida) Medical records department fax: (904) 346-0113 FUTURE EMPLOYMENT Cape Coral Emergency Physicians is an independent, democratic group of board certified emergency physicians who have been caring for patients at Cape Coral Hospital since 1985. Our emergency medicine physicians work cooperatively with Lee Health administration, nursing and ancillary staff to create and efficient, cohesive patient oriented team to deliver our excellent emergency care. BC/BE Emergency Physician Seeking full-time BC/BE Emergency Physician to join our practice. Equity in shifts. Compensation package one of the best in the nation. This 80K volume ED is located in Cape Coral which is one of the fastest growing cities. Minutes away from the Gulf of Mexico. Excellent family environment, as well as unsurpassed boating, salt water fishing and golf. Contact: admin@ccepfl.com Email for details Experienced Emergency Medicine NP/PA Experienced Emergency Medicine NP/PA wanted for Full and Part time positions. Beautiful Florida Gulf Coast community within close proximity to beaches, fishing and boating. Great autonomy and physician back up in a team environment. Competitive hourly pay with generous evening and night differential. Excellent compensation package for full time. Contact: a dmin@ccepfl.com Email for details Q: Why do I receive multiple bills for an emergency room visit? A: The hospital bills for facility charges, drugs, equipment and supplies, the physicians bill for the professional services your received from the physician staff while a patient in the ED. Q: Who do I contact regarding a physician bill? A: Refer to the telephone number or website on the particular bill. For the Cape Coral Emergency Physicians' bill, you can contact: Cape Coral Emergecny Physicians, LLC Department 1000 PO Box 986549 Boston, MA 02298-6549 For additional billing questions or issues contact Vantra Health billing@ventrahealth.com or call 1-800-418-5438 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET Q: I did not see a physician while in the emergency room why am I receiving a bill for service from them? A: You may have been treated by a Certified Physician Assistant (PA-C) or by an Advanced Registered Nurse Practitioner (ARNP). These highly trained, licensed and certified professionals are employed by the physician group and assist the physicians in the department by seeing and treating patients. Each patient case is reviewed with the Physician on duty who may or may not physically get involved in your care but has reviewed films, lab results and other diagnostic tests and agrees with the treatment plan and disposition the mid level provider has formulated Back To Top CCEP Website 2021
